Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.4882 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of F.I.R in Crime No. 296 of 2020 of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3. The petitioners are A-1 to A-3 in Crime No.296 of 2020 of Gangavaram Police station.

A case under Sections 188, 270, 273, 328 r/w 34 IPC, Sections 24(1) r/w 27 of the COTP Act, Section 3 of the Epidemic Diseases Act and under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was registered against them.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this is a covered matter and this Court, as per order, passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, quashed about 55 F.I.Rs registered against the petitioners therein based on identical facts with similar allegations.

Therefore,
he would submit that the petitioners are similarly placed and they are also entitled for quash of the F.I.R.
5.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor also fairly concedes that this is a covered matter and in the earlier order passed by this Court in the above batch of criminal petitions that this Court has quashed the F.I.Rs registered for similar offences.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate order accordingly.

6. As can be seen from the copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch passed by this Court, this Court has quashed about 55 F.I.Rs registered based on identical facts with similar allegations.
On the basis of the said order, this Court has also subsequently quashed the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences in Criminal Petition Nos.2600 and 4116 of 2020.

7. Therefore, in view of the aforesaid earlier orders passed by this Court whereby the F.I.Rs registered on identical facts with similar allegations were quashed, this Court is of the considered view that the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled to the similar relief.

CRLP/4882/2020 on 2 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90446049/
1 8.
In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
The F.I.R in Crime No. 296 of 2020 registered against the petitioners herein of Gangavaram Police Station, is hereby quashed.

JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date: 02-11-2020 AKN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY CRIMINAL PETITION No.4882 OF 2020 Date: 02-11-2020 AKN CRLP/4882/2020 on 2 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90446049/
